name: snow-device-management
description: Amazon Web Services Snow Device Management documentation.

subcommands.name: cancel-task
subcommands.description: Sends a cancel request for a specified task.

subcommands.name: create-task
subcommands.description: Instructs one or more devices to start a task, such as unlocking or rebooting.

subcommands.name: describe-device
subcommands.description: Checks device-specific information, such as the device type, software version, IP addresses, and lock status.

subcommands.name: describe-device-ec2-instances
subcommands.description: Checks the current state of the Amazon EC2 instances.

subcommands.name: describe-execution
subcommands.description: Checks the status of a remote task running on one or more target devices.

subcommands.name: describe-task
subcommands.description: Checks the metadata for a given task on a device.

subcommands.name: list-device-resources
subcommands.description: Returns a list of the Amazon Web Services resources available for a device.

subcommands.name: list-devices
subcommands.description: Returns a list of all devices on your Amazon Web Services account that have Amazon Web Services Snow Device Management enabled in the Amazon Web Services Region where the command is run.

subcommands.name: list-executions
subcommands.description: Returns the status of tasks for one or more target devices.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Returns a list of tags for a managed device or task.

subcommands.name: list-tasks
subcommands.description: Returns a list of tasks that can be filtered by state.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds or replaces tags on a device or task.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes a tag from a device or task.
